name: Dagger: Senka no Kizuna
source:
Humans, demons and spirits. 
These three species descended into a great war 
that has carried on through the ages. 

A survivor of that war, Tisto Rayer, possessed 
extraordinary powers, now living in quiet solitude. 

Each month, he traveled to the nearby town to purchase supplies. 

On his way home he came upon a young girl. 
Unable to turn his back on such a wretched thing he 
extended his hand. And the story begins. 

A first-person tale of a young man and the 
bonds he creates with girls in a war-ravaged fantasy world.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030119.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
人、魔、灵。
这三个物种陷入了一场伟大的战争 
这种情况历代以来一直延续着。

那场战争的幸存者蒂斯托·雷尔 (Tisto Rayer) 拥有 
非凡的力量，现在过着安静的孤独生活。

每个月，他都会前往附近的城镇购买物资。

在回家的路上，他遇到了一个年轻的女孩。
他无法拒绝这样一个可怜的东西 
伸出了手。故事开始了。

一个年轻人和一个人的第一人称故事 
他在饱受战争蹂躏的幻想世界中与女孩们建立了联系。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030119.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
